zh.d:
本版完成宝云 API 从 ¥5 试用到真实扫码支付、用量自助查询的商业闭环，同时带来跨会话协作、浏览器能力和内置技能扩容。

【新增】
· 【宝云充值】应用内可按自定义金额创建真实扫码支付订单；订单绑定安装 ID、重复轮询只入账一次，支付到账后余额更新并自动解除免费模型白名单，模型页直接显示可用余额
· 【宝云用量】新增独立仪表盘：应用安全带入 Key 直达，也支持手工粘贴已有 Key；按模型查看余额、消耗、订单和 Key 使用记录，早期 Key 已回填为可查询状态
· 【会话协作】@@ 可选择另一会话投递并显示状态；可把最近 50 条消息分享给自己的会话，企业成员可定向分享并导入为本地独立副本
· 【技能】新增 91 个内置技能，技能市场总数从 24 增至 115
· 【浏览器】新增网页阅读器；修复 one-browser / one-page-reader 显示已连接却没有注入会话的问题，现在智能体可直接读取当前页面

【优化改进】
· 宝云试用改为 ¥5，服务端限定经济型文本模型；试用模型从实时目录选择，付费后自动开放完整模型范围；异常丢失的试用 Key 可恢复
· 浏览器可一轮回答“当前打开什么页面”；跨会话内容以卡片呈现，充值、余额、用量入口与仪表盘更清晰

【修复】
· 【团队协作】修复“队长已排队 N 条”持续增长：同一成员槽位未读的 idle 通知只保留一条；点击停止会清掉既有 idle 积压但保留真实成员汇报，并要求队长向全员重新收集状态
· 修复 CDP 附加时序不稳定、多个已选技能重叠
· 修复记住密码、MCP 传输配置与 OAuth Token 明文落盘；试用服务不再信任可伪造的 X-Forwarded-For 绕过限流，CLI 凭据仅当前用户可读
· 修复余额胶囊和 41 个颜色类失效导致的空白/不可见界面

企业身份、目录同步、范围化权限和成员协作在本版完成端到端可用闭环。

【新增】
· 支持配置并使用标准 SAML 服务提供方登录、OIDC ID Token 的 JWKS 签名验证，以及 SCIM 2.0 用户和群组入站同步
· 新增范围化企业管理员角色及管理界面；管理员可触发集成同步和协作中继验证，成员可定向分享会话并导入副本

【优化改进】
· 平台和运维角色门禁按职责收敛；团队停止会清理积压空闲通知并重新同步，避免队列长期阻塞
· 企业侧的会话投递、协作中继和宝云订单转发链路完整可用

【修复】
· 修复两个成员加入死路、每个队友回合重复发送空闲通知，以及 SAML ACS 被 CSRF 错误拦截
· 企业侧 MCP/OAuth 凭据加密落盘，SCIM 离职处理和企业构建门禁稳定性修复

en.d:
This release completes the Baoyun API commercial flow from a ¥5 trial to real scan-to-pay and self-service usage, alongside conversation collaboration, browser capabilities, and more built-in skills.

[New]
· [Baoyun top-up] Create a real scan-to-pay order for a custom amount in the app. Each order is bound to the installation and credited exactly once; settlement updates the balance, lifts the free-model whitelist, and shows the available balance on Models
· [Baoyun usage] A standalone dashboard opens with secure app handoff or an existing pasted key, showing balance, per-model consumption, orders, and key usage; early keys have been backfilled for lookup
· [Conversation collaboration] @@ delivers to a selected conversation with status. Share the latest 50 messages to your own conversation; enterprise members can share directly and import an independent local copy
· [Skills] 91 built-in skills are added, taking the Skills Hub from 24 to 115
· [Browser] A page reader is included. one-browser and one-page-reader are now injected into conversations instead of merely appearing connected, so agents can read the current page

[Improved]
· Baoyun trials are ¥5 and server-side limited to an economical text model. Trial models come from the live catalog, payment unlocks the full model range, and a missing trial key can be recovered
· The browser answers what page is open in one round trip; deliveries render as cards and balance, top-up, and usage entry points are clearer

[Fixed]
· [Team collaboration] Fixed the lead's “N queued items” growing indefinitely: only one unread idle notice remains per teammate slot; Stop clears existing idle notices while preserving real teammate reports, then asks the lead to collect fresh status from everyone
· Fixed unreliable CDP attachment and overlapping selected skills
· Fixed plaintext storage of remembered passwords, MCP transport settings, and OAuth tokens; spoofable X-Forwarded-For no longer bypasses rate limits, and CLI credentials are owner-only
· Fixed blank or invisible UI caused by the balance pill and 41 broken colour classes

Enterprise identity, directory sync, scoped permissions, and member collaboration reach an end-to-end usable state.

[New]
· Configure and use standard SAML service-provider sign-in, JWKS validation for OIDC ID tokens, and inbound SCIM 2.0 user and group provisioning
· Scoped enterprise administrator roles and their UI are included. Administrators can run integration sync and collaboration-relay checks; members can share conversations directly and import copies

[Improved]
· Platform and DevOps guards are narrowed by responsibility. Stopping a team clears queued idle notices and re-syncs it instead of leaving the queue blocked
· Enterprise conversation delivery, collaboration relay, and Baoyun order relay are complete

[Fixed]
· Fixed two member-join dead ends, repeated idle notices on every teammate turn, and SAML ACS being incorrectly blocked by CSRF
· Enterprise MCP/OAuth credentials are encrypted at rest; SCIM offboarding and enterprise build gates are more reliable
